nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty Chill Reset Under Eye Patches

avis.texte: It's cute but did it really make a difference after one time? No but it was really fun during it and great for sleepovers and fun. I'm sure it moisturized but not enough for an extreme difference. Would buy again for fun!

avis.titre: I would buy this product multiples time over and over!
avis.texte: I absolutely love these eyes patches when I tell you they reduced the puffiness under my eyes quickly. They are also so cute as well so I highly recommend them.

I enjoyed using the Hello Kitty eye patches as apart of my morning skincare routine. I did chill them in the fridge before applying them and I liked how cooling they felt. My under eye was very moisturized and refreshed after using them I would buy them again to use or gift.

avis.titre: Hello Kitty Chill Reset Under Eye Patches
avis.texte: The Hello Kitty Chill Reset under-eye patches are honestly such a vibe. The packaging alone is adorable, but the actual patches feel cold, soothing, and instantly refreshing. I love that they stay in place without sliding around, and the gel texture makes them super comfortable for the full wear time. After about 10–15 minutes, my under-eyes look noticeably de-puffed and more awake. The hydration is legit too,my concealer goes on smoother afterward. They're perfect for mornings when you didn't get enough sleep or before a night out when you want that bright, snatched under-eye look.
I was very surprised using this product considering collabs don't have the best reputation. Definitely moisturizing and a nice relaxing self care item!
my eyes felt hydrated after using but honestly probably wouldn't repurchase. it doesn't do much. the design of the patches are really cute though!

avis.titre: I would definitely purchase and recommend to everyone!
avis.texte: I used this during a at home spa night. After washing my face and applying toner I sat these eye patches on for 20 minutes even though it's says for 15min. The extra 5 definitely didn't hurt but instead made my puffy bags calm down and smooth away. I definitely would add these into my skincare routine 3x a week.
I loved these under eye patches! They left my skin feeling super fresh and rejuvenated. I felt like after using them my eyes looked way less puffy than before!

After using the product, I can tell a difference under my eyes within the first use. I really did love the design of the eye mask also. Very easy to use. I can say they slide a little bit doesn't bother me too much

They felt really nice and soft from the moment I felt them, and instantly made my under eyes feel cooled and hydrated. I kept them on while I did my brows and lashes and by the time i took them off my concealer blended is so smooth. Chefs kiss

As someone who is always on the go, I was so excited to try these eye patches out. They were nice and cooling and simply just the 15 minutes of leaving them on made my eyes feeling instantly refreshed and smooth!

avis.titre: Everything you're looking for in eye patches!
avis.texte: These eye patches are a game changer for sure! Upon first glance, they are a great size and the packaging is super cute. I put them on and they were incredibly cooling and refreshing. My favorite thing about them is that they really don't budge once you put them under your eyes, they stay in place incredibly well! These are the absolute best eye patches I've ever tried!

avis.titre: So cute and so worth it
avis.texte: I used this product one night after my skincare routine and it really helped out my under eyes! Not to mention the packaging was adorable.

I have loved my experience trying out the Hello Kitty Chill Reset Under Eye Patches! I annoyingly have pretty sensitive skin on my face, but I had absolutely no problem using these eye patches. My under eyes felt so refreshed and hydrated after using these, so I think in the future I'm going to explore more of the skin care offered from the brand. I would recommend this product to anyone looking to trying out a quality product from CREME Shop! Also the Hello Kitty theming is absolutely adorable.

These are super cute and super fun to use. They actually work too, not only are they aesthetically cute. These would be the perfect gift for someone who loves Hello Kitty and skincare. I love the way these make my eyes feel and overall really enjoy these eye patches.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: I absolutely love these Hello Kitty under eye patches! The packaging is adorable, and the patches themselves feel soothing and refreshing as soon as they go on. After using them, my under-eye area looks brighter, less puffy, and much more hydrated. They stay in place really well and have a light, pleasant scent. Cute and effective. Definitely a new favorite in my skincare routine!

I was given this product to review and I was so pleased with these eye patches! They were cooling and refreshing, and they did not fall on my face like many eye patches do. They were easy to use, cute and felt really good on my eyes. I love eye patches so I will definitely repurchase these.

First off, I want to thank The Crème Shop and Bzz Agent for sending these adorable eyepatches for me to try out free of charge! These are absolutely ADORABLE! I love the Hello Kitty packaging and print on the actual product. The cucumber and chamomile are so cooling, hydrating, and refreshing. I used these after I returned from traveling and they helped me immediately feel rehydrated and revitalized. As someone with sensitive skin, these felt so gentle and they were unscented! Sometimes other under eye masks can have a scent that makes my eyes kind of sting and water, which can be unpleasant but these were fragrance free. The only complaint that I have is that they kept sliding down my cheeks as I moved around, but it wasn't a dealbreaker for me. The material was different from other products I've tried where they felt like the combination of a fabric mask and a hydrogel mask which was really interesting and I really liked! I can't wait to buy these to use again! Fingers crossed I can grab some products with other Sanrio characters too!
It feels super hydrating and refreshing, as-well as soft for the skin!

avis.titre: I would recommend this item but only because
avis.texte: The packaging was cute and I love Hello Kitty. I have dark circles and love using anything that keeps my eyes looking less exhausted and tired. The patches made me feel refreshed and hydrated.

I used this with a face mask and left it on for about 20 minutes. The packaging and actual product itself is so adorable. The hydrogen patches stayed on and didn't move at all even though I was cleaning and eating breakfast while they were on. My undereyes feel nice and hydrated, I would use them again!
These eye patches were really cooling and relaxing. Kept my under eyes moisturized and soothed. Good for dry skin.

These eye patches feel cooling and soothing from the moment they go on, and they help reduce puffiness in a gentle way. The hydration leaves the under-eye area smoother and refreshed, and they stay in place well while you wear them. They are a simple, relaxing pick-me-up that makes tired eyes look more awake. The Crème Shop sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program.

This was my first time trying under eyes patches and I've got to say this was pretty relaxing! It doesn't take too long to apply and once 15 minutes pass you rub the serum in and it leaves the under eyes smooooooth. (Bonus points since they were super cute too) I would definitely use this product again!
The packaging was too cute and I love Hello Kitty. I have dark circles and love using anything that keeps my eyes looking less exhausted and tired. The patches made me feel refreshed and hydrated.

I received these as a sample and i absolutely loved them. I'll be using them in my stockings this holiday season and keep them in my regular skin care routine!! My under eyes get pretty bad towards the middle of the week and I decided to try these patches while relaxing and they helped my under bags so much! They are so so refreshing the chamomile in them helps so much with inflammation and puffiness! These are so cute and definitely worth it.

avis.titre: Need more for all of our Spa Nights💙🥰
avis.texte: My daughter and I were so excited to be picked to try these under eye patches by the Crème shop X Hello Kitty! I have been a Hello kitty lover since I was young AA well AA my daughter! My daughter is obsessed with skin care routines and has definitely added this to her nightly checklist! She said it was refreshing and "feels like someone just splashed her face with cold water in the best way" her skin wa a left felling so smooth. There was no oil residue left over either which we love!

avis.titre: Must have after a long week!!
avis.texte: This was my first time using this eye patch, and I was honestly surprised at how hydrating it is. As soon as I put it on, it felt cool, soothing, and really gentle on my skin. After taking it off, the area under my eyes looked refreshed, smoother, and way more moisturized. It didn't feel sticky or heavy just soft and hydrated. I definitely noticed a difference, especially with how bright and awake my eyes looked. I would use it again for sure.

I was so excited to try these Hello Kitty Under Eye Patches as a gift from the brand! When unpackaging them, they were super cute, and the design was as pictured on the packaging. They adhered to my undereyes well and provided a refreshing and cooling feeling. I would definitely recommend!
My step daughter loved this she is into skin care now and was supper excited once this arrived and wants to get more 10/10
These cute eye patches hydrate the undereyes really well. Its amazing to use on day to day bases or before makeup. Leaves my eyes smooth and feeling fresh

Thanks, Crème shop for the free product! I love creme shops face masks and eye patches they truly never miss and this hello kitty eye patch set is no exception. They are cooling and calming on the thin skin under my eyes and definitely helps at least reduce the feeling of heavy bags. You would need to regularly wear these to get rid of the look of under eye bags, but as a one time wear, they are definitely calming. Would absolutely recommend these!
I love sanrio so love these because they're cute but they also smell great and feel great. very satisfied:)

I love the hydration i get from these eyepatches. The packaging is very cute and any Hello Kitty fan will love it. The chamomile makes it smell so good and they don't slip off your face. The cucumber extract reduced the puffiness and dark circles under my eyes.
